This is a factual index of short item names and their source identifiers, not a catalogue of copied item descriptions.

An entry does not establish that an item is obtainable, equipped in a particular slot, sold by a particular character, or assigned any particular stat. Those claims require separate evidence.

'''Spoilers:''' the index may reveal names before they appear in your playthrough. Duplicate or unused labels may exist.
